entries.title: About IIT
entries.answer: The Informatics Institute of Technology was founded in Colombo in 1990 by Dr. Gamini Wickramasinghe, starting as the Informatics Institute of Computer Studies with 22 students and 6 lecturers. It offers IT, business and innovation education, and was the first private institute in Sri Lanka to offer British degrees.

entries.title: Partner universities
entries.answer: IIT's undergraduate degrees in Business and Information Technology are offered in partnership with the University of Westminster and Robert Gordon University in the UK. Other academic partners include the University of Hertfordshire, Macquarie University and Western Sydney University.

entries.title: Contact IIT
entries.answer: You can call the IIT hotline on +94 766 760 760 or email info@iit.ac.lk.

entries.title: IIT campuses
entries.answer: The Main Campus is at 57 Ramakrishna Road, Colombo 6. The City Campus is at 435 Galle Road, Colombo 3. The School of Computing is at 10 Trelawney Place, Colombo 4, and the Business School is at 528 R. A. De Mel Mawatha, Colombo 3.

entries.title: Regional centres
entries.answer: IIT has a regional centre in Galle at 36 Colombo Road, Kaluwella, phone +94 76 256 2563, and one in Kurunegala at 109 Bauddhaloka Mawatha, phone +94 744 430 060.

entries.title: How to apply
entries.answer: Local students register in person at the Main Campus, 57 Ramakrishna Road, Colombo 6. It's best to book an appointment with the admissions office or a careers counsellor first, and the process includes an interview where you must be present. International students can email admissions@iit.ac.lk.

entries.title: Undergraduate degrees
entries.answer: Undergraduate degrees include Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, AI and Data Engineering, Business Computing, Business Data Analytics, Fintech with Data Analytics, Business Management, and a Bachelor of Business Administration.

entries.title: Postgraduate degrees
entries.answer: Postgraduate programmes include MSc AI Engineering, Applied Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Information Technology, Big Data Analytics, Cyber Security and Forensics, Advanced Software Engineering, and an MA in Fashion Business Management.

entries.title: Foundation programmes
entries.answer: The IIT International Foundation offers UK accredited diplomas in Business Technology, Computing, and Business Management.

entries.title: Campus facilities
entries.answer: IIT has air-conditioned classrooms, a student lounge, a library with over 10,000 books, a cafeteria, an on-campus swimming pool and sports facilities.

entries.title: Admissions Office
entries.answer: The Admissions Office is on the Ground Floor, to your left at Spencer Building

entries.title: Main Auditorium
entries.answer: The Main Auditorium is on the 5th Floor at GP Square Building

entries.title: Deans and heads
entries.answer: The Dean (Academic) is Ruvan Weerasinghe. Dr. Dilhari Attygalle is the Dean of the School of Computing, and Prof. P.S.M. Gunaratne is the Dean of the IIT Business School. Prof. Nihal Kodikara is Head of Department at the IIT School of Computing.

entries.title: About Cynobot
entries.answer: I'm Cynobot, Cynocor's first human-sized AI assistant robot, working here as IIT's robot receptionist. I was built by Cynocor, a startup our team started to build projects like me.

entries.title: About Cynocor
entries.answer: Cynocor is a startup that builds software, automation, AI and IoT systems, from web and mobile platforms to AI workflows. Its mission is to architect and deploy advanced systems that let clients scale without friction. You can find it at cynocor.com.lk.

entries.title: Cynocor team
entries.answer: The Cynocor team is Chanul Dilhara, who leads product direction and technical architecture; Ravindu Umapathi, business development and strategy; Chamupathi Dewdunu, systems engineering and cloud infrastructure; Amanya Rubasinghe, product experience and UI design; Thejana Thathsara, cybersecurity; and Ashendra Liyanage, quality assurance and testing.

entries.title: Contact Cynocor
entries.answer: You can reach Cynocor at cynocorofficial@gmail.com or call +94 74 232 1760, which is also on WhatsApp. The website is cynocor.com.lk.
